summary: You can now see both update schedules in one place, and every managed tenant can pull on demand.

new.title: Both schedules on one page
new.text: The Job schedule page now shows the daily software update beside the definitions pull, with its timing, its ring and where to change it.

fixes.title: Run pull now on every managed tenant
fixes.text: Before, only locally hosted managed tenants offered Run pull now. Every managed tenant now shows its pull schedule and the button.

fixes.title: Clearer replication label
fixes.text: An empty replication value now reads "No replication to managed tenants (default)" instead of "(blank)". Your data is unchanged.
